results.prompt: Brew me a Modern deck built around Thud, Plunge into Darkness and Spoils of the Vault.
results.text:
# Rakdos "Thud Shadow": Modern brew

## The plan
This deck pays its own life on purpose. Fetchlands, shocklands, Thoughtseize, Street Wraith cycling, Spoils of the Vault and Plunge into Darkness all lower your life. Death's Shadow is a 13/13 that gets -X/-X, where X is your life total, so every point you lose makes it bigger. At 4 life it's a 9/9. You can attack with it, or sacrifice it to Thud ("deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target") for 1 mana and hit the opponent's face for 8–12 out of nowhere. Spoils and Plunge are both ways to lose life and ways to find whichever half of the combo you're missing.

## Decklist (60)
**Creatures (16)**
- 4 Death's Shadow
- 4 Street Wraith
- 3 Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer
- 3 Nethergoyf
- 2 Scourge of the Skyclaves

**Spells (26)**
- 4 Thud
- 4 Spoils of the Vault
- 3 Plunge into Darkness
- 4 Thoughtseize
- 4 Mishra's Bauble
- 3 Lightning Bolt
- 3 Unholy Heat
- 1 Fatal Push

**Lands (18)**
- 4 Bloodstained Mire
- 2 Marsh Flats
- 1 Arid Mesa
- 1 Polluted Delta
- 1 Verdant Catacombs
- 1 Wooded Foothills
- 2 Blood Crypt
- 2 Sulfurous Springs
- 3 Swamp
- 1 Mountain

**Sideboard (15)**
- 3 Leyline of the Void
- 2 Kolaghan's Command
- 2 Damping Sphere
- 2 Blood Moon
- 2 Collective Brutality
- 2 Terminate
- 1 Duress
- 1 Meltdown

## Why these cards
- **Spoils of the Vault** (1 mana, instant): you name a card, then reveal cards until you find it, losing 1 life for each other card revealed. That life loss feeds Shadow.
  - With Shadow already in play, name Thud. With Thud in hand, name Shadow.
  - **Warning:** it can kill you. With 4 copies of the named card, expect to reveal about 10 cards. Cast it at a healthy life total, and don't cast it below about 8 life unless it wins on the spot.
- **Plunge into Darkness** (2 mana, instant):
  - Its "pay X life, look at X cards, take one" mode digs for Thud or Shadow and shrinks your life at the end of the opponent's turn.
  - Its sacrifice mode gains 3 life per creature. That's an emergency reset if you've dropped too low, for example by sacrificing a Ragavan or Nethergoyf.
- **Scourge of the Skyclaves**: its power and toughness equal 20 minus the highest life total among players. It's a second big creature to Thud once both players are low. It's weaker when the opponent's life is still high, so there are only 2.
- **Street Wraith and Mishra's Bauble**: these are almost free cards that thin the deck, so 18 lands is enough. Wraith cycles for 2 life, which also grows Shadow.
- **Ragavan, Nethergoyf, Bolt, Unholy Heat and Thoughtseize**: this is the Death's Shadow archetype's proven support (the tool showed Thoughtseize ×4, Bolt ×4 and Heat ×4 in its list), so the deck can win normally when the combo doesn't come together.

**Odds:** with no mulligans, you'll see at least one of Shadow, Scourge or Spoils plus at least one Thud or Plunge by turn 4 on the play **63.1%** of the time. That number doesn't count the extra cards from Street Wraith, Bauble or Plunge's digging, so the real figure is higher.

## The mana
- There are 18 lands and the average mana value is 1.4.
- Every fetchland can find Blood Crypt, so all ten count as both black and red sources. Fetch for basics when you can, to stay safe from Blood Moon.
- Sulfurous Springs pings you for colored mana, which suits this deck.
- Black is the main color (Shadow, Spoils, Plunge, Thoughtseize). Red covers Thud, Bolt, Heat and Ragavan.

## Sideboarding against the field
The meta tool showed Energy 14.5%, Blink 14.4%, Prowess 9.8%, Affinity 8.6%, Domain Zoo 8.2%, Storm 4.9% and Goryo's Vengeance 3.3%.
- **Prowess, Energy and Zoo:** these decks attack your low life total. Bring in Terminate and Collective Brutality, which can drain 2 life back to you. Take out a Spoils and a Plunge, play Shadow less aggressively, and count on Plunge's sacrifice mode to gain life back.
- **Affinity:** bring in Kolaghan's Command, Meltdown and Terminate. Take out Thoughtseize.
- **Storm and Goryo's Vengeance:** bring in Duress and Damping Sphere against Storm, and Leyline of the Void against Goryo's. Take out removal.
- **Blink, Amulet Titan and Eldrazi:** bring in Blood Moon and Damping Sphere. Keep the hand disruption in.

## Label and caveats
**This is a brew.** No tournament list in the results runs Thud, Spoils or Plunge; all three show 0 lists in the last 90 days. I took the shell (discard, burn, Ragavan, Wraith, Bauble, fetches) from the Death's Shadow archetype data, but that data is based on **only one list**. Treat the land count and the exact numbers as a starting point, not tested results. The sideboard is my own choice for the current meta, not copied from any list.

plan.thesis: Fetches, shocks, Thoughtseize, Street Wraith, Spoils of the Vault and Plunge into Darkness push our own life total down, so Death's Shadow (and late Scourge of the Skyclaves) becomes a huge creature. We either attack with it or Thud it at the opponent's face for 8-12 damage out of nowhere, using Spoils/Plunge to find whichever half is missing.
